newsitem.title: USA: Tropical storm may hit eastern Cuba by Friday -WSC.
newsitem.headline: Tropical storm may hit eastern Cuba by Friday -WSC.

text.p: Tropical Storm Marco, currently weakening and nearly stationary in the Caribbean, may hit eastern Cuba by Friday, independent forecaster Weather Services Corp said.
Heavy rain may lead to flash flooding over areas from eastern Cuba through Jamaica, the island of Hispaniola and western Puerto Rico during the next day or so, WSC said.
Heavy rains not directly associated with Marco may also cause local flooding over Central America.

The storm, with 50 mph winds, is about 195 miles south of Kingston, Jamaica, where a tropical storm warning has been called. Marco may begin to drift north-northeastward toward Jamaica during the next 24 hours, possibly weakening slowly, and is a threat to shipping in the region.
